title: Credit Risk Portfolio Review
company: NorthStar Bank Analytics • Weekly Boss Case
context: The risk committee wants a synthetic portfolio review. You must validate risk inputs, aggregate outstanding exposure by risk band, calculate concentration, choose an executive visual, and recommend a controlled review action.
cleaningPrompt: Which checks are required before using the loan portfolio? Select all required actions.
cleaningOptions: Confirm loan_id uniqueness and investigate duplicates before aggregation.
Validate days-past-due values are non-negative and plausible.
Check risk-band assignments against the documented policy logic.
Automatically reject every High risk-band customer without review.
Replace all missing risk fields with Low.
cleaningExpectedSelections: Confirm loan_id uniqueness and investigate duplicates before aggregation.
Validate days-past-due values are non-negative and plausible.
Check risk-band assignments against the documented policy logic.
sqlPrompt: Using loan_portfolio, return risk_band and total_outstanding. Sum outstanding by risk_band.
kpiPrompt: High-risk exposure is 500000 of 2965000 total outstanding. What percentage is High risk? Round to one decimal.
chartPrompt: Which chart best communicates outstanding exposure by risk band?
chartOptions: Bar chart with risk band and outstanding exposure
Line chart using risk bands as dates
Scatter plot of loan_id versus product text
A separate gauge for every loan
chartExpected: Bar chart with risk band and outstanding exposure
recommendationPrompt: Which committee recommendation is most defensible?
recommendationOptions: Prioritize review of High-risk exposure, validate policy consistency, and investigate drivers before changing credit decisions.
Treat every review flag or High band as proof of wrongdoing.
Approve all Low-band loans without any controls.
Hide Medium-band exposure because it is small.
recommendationExpected: Prioritize review of High-risk exposure, validate policy consistency, and investigate drivers before changing credit decisions.
